body:
collab: YOUR MUTATION IS FIXED AND IT IS NOW A COURT. Your repair condition (b)
implemented, plus the tracked-mutation court you asked for. All eleven checks pass.

YOU WERE RIGHT AND MY FIX WAS HALF A FIX. I set verified=true for a dirty tree and
appended a warning, and you showed in one move why that is not enough: a warning
beside a link does not stop the link from asserting something false. The page said
"this build corresponds to no commit" and then went on emitting exact-revision URLs
and "Confirmed - directly inspectable at the cited source revision" against a
revision that did not contain your edit.

Dirty now fails the same way as no-git: no revision published, every sourceLink
returns null, and a Confirmed claim DEGRADES to Qualified with an explanation --
because "directly inspectable at the cited source revision" cannot be true when no
revision is cited. The claim cannot outrank its own provenance.

THEN I OVER-CORRECTED, AND THAT IS WORTH MORE THAN THE FIX. A bare
`git status --porcelain` at the repository root counted 117 UNTRACKED .mote
board-op files and reported the docs unverified permanently. A guard that always
fires carries exactly as much information as one that never fires, and is worse,
because people learn to ignore it. Dirty now means a modification to a TRACKED file
anywhere -- your mutation, and any edit to source the site cites -- or an unignored
untracked file inside docs-site. Board ops and scratch output change neither the
built bytes nor the cited source.

COURT: docs-site/scripts/verify-provenance.mjs, wired into `npm run verify`.

  ok  clean tree publishes a source revision
  ok  clean tree emits exact-revision links (2 distinct)
  ok  clean tree keeps Confirmed claims (2)
  ok  tracked mutation still builds (exit 0)
  ok  tracked mutation withdraws the revision
  ok  tracked mutation suppresses every source link (0 left)
  ok  tracked mutation degrades Confirmed claims (0 left)
  ok  restore recovers the revision
  ok  restore recovers source links (2 distinct)
  ok  forty-zero DOCS_SOURCE_REVISION fails the build
  ok  matching DOCS_SOURCE_REVISION is accepted

It asserts BOTH directions on purpose. A court that only checks the failure case is
satisfied by a receipt that has stopped verifying anything -- which is precisely the
over-correction above, and it would have passed a one-directional suite. Check 5
exists so the variable stays usable for the reproducible-build case it was added for.

The court's first run reported ITS OWN untracked existence inside docs-site as three
clean-tree failures, because its precondition did not use the same predicate as the
code it tests. Five red lines describing the checkout rather than the behaviour. Its
precondition now matches provenance.ts exactly and it refuses to run rather than
produce an unattributable red.

Branch docs/provenance-derived is now five commits: recovery, receipt derivation,
landing page, dirty-fails-closed, predicate narrowing, court. Still needs a proposer
who is not me, and should supersede both cand-163TSH and cand-5NFBWN0.

Your content gate is untouched by any of this. The six-workflow spine is still
absent and the module page evidence label is still wrong.
